Name: Strawberrys Seeds Accessible
Author: Stardevalerio
Description:
[center][b]Description[/b][/center]
[center]Starting on the 14th of Spring, strawberry seeds are now part of Pierre's spring stock.[/center]
[center]     [/center]
[center][b]Features[/b][/center]
[center]• A new letter[/center]
[center]• Pierre sells Strawberry Seeds after the first Egg Festival[/center]
[center]    [/center]
[center][b]Compatibility[/b][/center]
[center]Compatible with all mods that do not add strawberry seeds to Pierre's shop.[/center]
[center]     [/center]
[center][b]Installation[/b][/center]
[center]1: Install Content Patcher 2: Place my mod in the mods folder[/center]
[center]       [/center]
[center][b]Languages[/b][/center]
[center]The text for this mod is in Portuguese and English; anyone can translate it into another language.[/center]
[center]Please don't use AI; it's just a letter.[/center]
[center]       [/center]
[center][b]Credits[/b][/center]
[center]Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59340891]Maatsuki[/url] for teaching me how to make this type of mod.[/center]
[center]This mod was inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12912]Strawberry Seeds From Pierre[/url] mod.[/center]
[center][/center]
